name: Aberystwyth University

settingEvidence.evidence: The University's main teaching campus, Penglais is located on Penglais Hill overlooking the town and Seafront.

fees.text: £9,790 per year for Home (UK) undergraduate students (the current 2026/27 fee, set at the Welsh Government maximum regulated fee; Home fee status covers students from the UK). Aberystwyth says this could change for 2027 entry, so the 2027/28 fee is not confirmed yet.

source.evidence: The current tuition fee for undergraduate Home students is £9,790/year. This could change for 2027 entry and current students and applicants will be informed as above.

livingCosts.text: University self-catered single rooms cost about £124–£216 a week in 2026/27 (£4,839–£8,629 a year on 39–40 week contracts), including energy, wifi, contents insurance and Sports Centre membership. Catered, Welsh-medium Pantycelyn is £229 a week for 33 weeks (includes a £2,226 meal allowance).

source.evidence: Cwrt Mawr | Single | 4,839 | 124.08 … Fferm Penglais (Studio) | Single | 8,629 | 215.73

openDays.text: Next open day: Saturday 7 November 2026 (register on the open days page). No later dates are listed yet.

source.evidence: Our next open day will take place on Saturday, 7 November. Register below.

contextual.summary: Applicants who have been in care, are estranged from their parents, have caring responsibilities, live in a disadvantaged area, have refugee or asylum seeker status, or are the first in their immediate family to go to university may get an offer towards the lower end of the typical range.
contextual.typicalReduction: Up to two grades, or up to 16 UCAS tariff points, lower than the typical entry requirement (an offer towards the lower end of the typical range).

criteria.detail: Live in a disadvantaged area (based on your home post code). The page doesn't say which area measure is used.
Have Refugee or Asylum Seeker Status
Are the first in your immediate family to go to university
Take part in the Welsh Government's Seren Network: email admissions@aber.ac.uk so Aberystwyth can make sure you're considered for a contextual offer.

contextual.rulesText: Depending on your situation, you may receive an offer towards the lower end of the typical entry requirement range. Aberystwyth receives this information directly from UCAS, so contextual offers are only available to applicants who apply through UCAS. Subject-specific requirements (for example a certain grade in a subject) still apply. The page doesn't say how many criteria you need to meet.

source.evidence: you may receive an offer towards the lower end of our typical entry requirement range (this can be up to two grades, or up to 16 UCAS tariff points lower than our typical entry requirement)

programmes.name: Access All Aber
programmes.summary: Five-day summer residential for Year 12 students from widening participation backgrounds, with sessions across many subjects (including International Politics) and a contextual offer for those who complete it.
programmes.whoCanApply: Year 12 students from widening participation backgrounds. The full criteria (and whether students from outside Wales can apply) were not found on an official page.
programmes.eligibilityDetail: Aberystwyth says the programme is designed for young people from Widening Participation backgrounds; detailed criteria are not published on the pages checked.
benefits: Five days in university halls (Pantycelyn, Penglais Campus) with lectures across many subjects, visits and evening social events
Certificate and a contextual offer for those who completed the 2025 programme (for September 2026 entry)
programmes.offerReduction: Completers of the 2025 programme received a contextual offer (Aberystwyth says contextual offers can be up to two grades, or 16 UCAS tariff points, below the typical entry requirement).
programmes.subjects: All subjects (sessions across many departments, including International Politics)

runs.text: A five-day programme in summer; the 2025 one was reported on 11 July 2025. 2027 dates not announced.

programmes.infoNote: Based on a July 2025 news report. The programme's own page returned 404 when checked on 2026-10-21, so no 2026 or 2027 details were found.

source.evidence: Seventy Year 12 pupils took part in Access All Aber, a five-day programme … received a certificate and a contextual offer for a place to study at Aberystwyth University in September 2026.

notConfirmed: Eligibility criteria (including whether students from outside Wales can take part) are not published on any page found
Cost, 2026/2027 dates and application deadline not found; the programme's page returned 404
